--!strict
local into = workspace:FindFirstChild(script:GetAttribute("Into") or "ScriptEnabledSpec")
local p = Instance.new("Part")
p.Name = script:GetAttribute("Make") :: string
p.Parent = into

--!strict
local into = workspace:FindFirstChild(script:GetAttribute("Into") or "ScriptEnabledSpec")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = "Tick"
    p.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild(script:GetAttribute("Into") :: string)
end)

--!strict
task.delay(0.1, function()
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = "TooLate"
    p.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("ScriptEnabledSpec")
end)

--!strict
local function mark(name: string)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = name
    p.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("ScriptEnabledSpec")
end
script.Destroying:Connect(function()
    mark("Cleaned")
end)
mark("Connected")

--!strict
local watched = workspace:FindFirstChild("ScriptDestroyedWatched") :: Instance
watched.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = "Heard"
    p.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("ScriptEnabledSpec")
end)
